title: PETG for everyday prints, PA6-CF for strong ones
summary: The frame prints in either filament. PETG is the everyday one: it needs nothing extra on the U1, and on this frame it weighs 16.2 g, its first mode is 143 Hz, and it survives a 2.04 m drop (C15 asks 1 m) and a 1.67 m/s wall hit. The crash claims C15 and C16 are judged in PA6-CF (strong_material), the filament for anyone serious about strength: 13.8 g, 196 Hz, 8.12 m and 3.66 m/s. Of the seven filaments CalculiX checked on the same shape, only it and PAHT-CF clear both crash floors. The owner's brief: most people print PETG casually, nylon is for hardcore builders, and PETG breakability is not a worry.

the soft arcs lower the first mode to 136 Hz and gain nothing in a crash (1.94 m, 1.61 m/s)
